name: code-review
title_zh: 合代码前先过一遍仓库规矩的 gh 评审员
tagline_zh: PR 一上来就按你仓库的约定逐条核对，不靠通用模板。它先读 CONTRIBUTING 和现有代码风格，再挑刺。
tagline_en: Checks each PR against your codebase's stated rules, not generic templates. Reads CONTRIBUTING and code style.
desc_en: Reviews GitHub CLI (gh) pull requests against codebase conventions
why_zh: 它不套通用规则，而是先解析仓库里的约定文件，再对照 PR 逐项检查，像老同事一样懂你们项目的脾气。
why_en: It adapts to your project's conventions instead of applying generic rules, parsing local docs and style to catch what matters to.
limit_zh: 只针对 GitHub CLI 的 PR 做静态审查，不跑测试、不查运行时问题；需要仓库有明确的约定文档。
limit_en: Only static review of gh PRs; no tests or runtime checks. Needs explicit convention docs in repo, else advice stays generic.
title_en: A gh reviewer that checks PRs against repo rules
